question: In the isoprene recovery process simulation, which thermodynamic model was used for the steam stripping section, and how many stages does the column in that section have?
expect: UNIFAC; the stripper has 35 stages (abstract; sec. 2.1)
rendered:
<document title="Process Simulation of Isoprene Recovery from Dilute Fermentation Off-Gas Using Absorption-Desorption">

The thermodynamic model used for the steam stripping section is not explicitly stated in the provided text. However, it is mentioned that a direct activity-coefficient description of the liquid phase was preferred due to the stripper operating near atmospheric pressure, where vapor-phase nonideality is negligible.

The column in the steam stripping section is not explicitly stated to have a specific number of stages. However, it is mentioned that the stripper carries a much smaller vapor (steam) flow and therefore has a comparatively negligible pressure drop, which was neglected; it was modeled at constant 1 bar.
